'''Altagak's Fangs''' was an [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] assigned to [[Strike Force Altagak]] deployed to [[Mentanar Vosk]]. Consisting of ten veteran [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], the squad was equipped with [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]] and a single [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]].
